statement: Most New Zealand companies pay income tax on their profit at a flat rate of 28%.
caveat: Look-through companies and some other structures are taxed differently, and the rate is set by the Income Tax Act 2007 schedule 1 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23); rate changes arrive at fiscal events. Check the live Inland Revenue page before relying.
